scope: Executable profiles and the specific independent oracle fixtures recorded in each report. Native backends and outer-folder diagnostics are separate; no universal correctness or full parameter coverage claim.

operations.title: Find bridges between people or places
operations.description: All-source betweenness centrality; optional weights are positive path lengths.

operations.title: Rank the number of connections
operations.description: Degree centrality or raw degree with explicit direction.

operations.title: Choose starting points that maximize expected diffusion
operations.description: Exact rational enumeration of seed sets and live-edge states using NetworkX reachability. Supports independent cascade and uniform-random linear threshold; supplied fixed thresholds use progressive activation. Parallel IC probabilities combine as 1-product(1-p); LT weights sum. Exponential reference method with explicit work budgets, no sampling or unsupported statistical promises.

vertex_thresholds.description: Fixed LT thresholds as {vertex,value} rows for every vertex. Null selects independent uniform thresholds. Zero fixed thresholds activate even without active predecessors.

operations.title: Rank overall influence
operations.description: Converged global PageRank with a checked fixed-point residual.

operations.title: Rank connections around selected starting points
operations.description: Converged personalized PageRank with explicit direction, dangling-node behavior and residual checks.

operations.title: Count or list complete groups of a chosen size
operations.description: Exact k-clique counting/enumeration with k>=2 and no implementation-imposed upper k bound.

operations.title: Find complete groups that cannot be extended
operations.description: Enumerate maximal cliques; these are not necessarily maximum-size cliques.

operations.title: Find the largest fully connected group
operations.description: Exact maximum clique, with optional enumeration of every tied optimum.

operations.title: Assign non-conflicting groups
operations.description: A valid greedy coloring at distance one or two; the number of colors is not claimed minimal.

operations.title: Divide a network into communities
operations.description: Louvain for heuristic modularity; checked binary partition optimization for exact modularity or CPM. CPM is internal edge weight minus resolution times the number of within-community vertex pairs.

operations.title: Find a community around required seed vertices
operations.description: NetworkX personalized PageRank followed by a weighted-degree-normalized sweep. All seeds are required; the lowest defined conductance among feasible sweep prefixes is selected. This is a heuristic, with recomputed cut and volume, and makes no global optimality claim. Parallel weights sum; self-loops are rejected.

operations.title: Find overlapping tightly connected groups
operations.description: Exact k-clique percolation communities. Membership may overlap.

operations.title: Minimum graph edit cost
operations.description: Exact reference edit distance between simple directed/undirected graphs using NetworkX rational shortest paths over partial correspondences. Exact vertex-label replacement costs insertion+deletion; equal selected labels cost zero. Edge relabeling competes with deletion+insertion. Weights/times/unselected attributes are ignored. Returns an ordered edit script on normalized graphs with stable handles and original IDs. Exponential work is budgeted; no timed-out or approximate result is advertised as optimal.

vertex_label_fields.description: Distinct selected categorical fields: label and/or type. Missing differs from empty.

edge_label_fields.description: Either [type] or [] for no edge category.

parallel_edges.description: Collapse retains the first edge and requires equal selected types unless labels are ignored.

edit_costs.description: Optional nonnegative decimal costs: vertex_insertion, vertex_deletion, edge_insertion, edge_deletion, edge_substitution. Each defaults to 1. Vertex-label replacement is their insertion+deletion sum, so independent vertex_substitution is not accepted.

operations.title: Largest common subgraph by vertex count
operations.description: Exact maximum vertex count, with a checked graph and injective correspondence. Induced matching uses NetworkX VF2 on successively smaller subsets. Non-induced matching permits disconnected/edgeless results and uses maximum label-compatible matching; it does not maximize the number of edges. Preserves direction and selected categorical labels; ignores weights/times. Exponential induced search is budgeted.

vertex_label_fields.description: Distinct selected categorical fields: label and/or type. Missing differs from empty.

edge_label_fields.description: Either [type] or [] for no edge category.

parallel_edges.description: Collapse retains the first edge and requires equal selected types unless labels are ignored.

operations.title: Align two graphs while conserving topology and supplied similarities
operations.description: SciPy/HiGHS linearized quadratic assignment for a global one-to-one mapping covering every vertex of the smaller graph. Maximizes topology_weight times conserved-edge value plus supplied pair similarities. Weighted conservation uses the minimum of the two normalized nonnegative edge weights; unweighted conservation counts edges.

node_similarity_prior.description: Rows with graph_a_vertex, graph_b_vertex, value; unspecified pairs have prior zero.

operations.title: Find fragile connections and cut vertices
operations.description: Exact biconnected vertex blocks, bridges and articulation points of an undirected graph.

operations.title: Find connected groups
operations.description: Exact weakly or strongly connected components, including isolated vertices.

operations.title: Group vertices and build their weighted quotient graph
operations.description: Use a supplied partition or NetworkX maximal matching, then aggregate all fine-edge weights and numeric vertex feature vectors by the declared rule.

cluster_assignment.description: One {vertex, value} row per vertex, with integer cluster values.

operations.title: Build a graph from nearby feature vectors
operations.description: Exact all-pairs SciPy distance search with explicit self-exclusion, metric and symmetrization. Equal-distance ties follow original vector order.

operations.title: Reduce edges while measuring Laplacian distortion
operations.description: Static effective-resistance sampling with replacement and importance reweighting, using SciPy grounded Laplacian solves. Measures all generalized eigenvalues, not only sampled vectors. An explicit epsilon must pass that numerical check. An edge budget alone permits disclosed distortion. Requires undirected, explicitly weighted simple input; loops and parallel edges are rejected; zero-weight edges can be dropped.

edge_budget.description: At most this many edges; repeated draws merge. A budget covering all positive edges returns the identity sparsifier.

epsilon.description: Optional strict target 0<epsilon<1, checked by generalized eigenvalues in float64; failure asks for a larger edge budget.

operations.title: Find the well-connected core
operations.description: Exact core numbers and an optional induced k-core.

operations.title: Find connections supported by triangles
operations.description: Exact edge truss numbers and an optional k-truss edge set.

operations.title: Generate candidate record pairs and resolve entities using declared rules
operations.description: RapidFuzz Levenshtein and declared equality/token/numeric predicates generate complete candidate pairs. NetworkX components provide transitive resolution; SciPy/HiGHS can minimize unit candidate-pair disagreements instead. Noncandidate pairs are neutral; clusters never cross candidate-graph components. Input graph edges are unused hints, not match decisions.

blocking_rules.description: Nonempty rules with id and all predicates. Each predicate needs field (attributes path), operator (eq/shared_token/edit_distance/numeric_difference), optional=false, normalization=none|casefold|nfkc_casefold. Distance operators require nonnegative max_distance (integer for edit distance). Rules form a disjunction; predicates within each all form a conjunction.

match_decision_rule.description: An all predicate array, required for resolution.

operations.title: Find exactly k vertices with the greatest internal edge value
operations.description: Binary vertex/edge optimization with an exact cardinality constraint; solver optimality and the recomputed objective are checked.

operations.title: Find the region with the most edges or cliques per vertex
operations.description: Maximize induced k-clique count / vertex count. k is clique order, not result size. Weighted density is defined only for k=2.

operations.title: Find maximal completely connected groups across two sides
operations.description: A clique reduction followed by NetworkX maximal-clique enumeration; both biclique sides must be nonempty.

operations.title: Find groups meeting a minimum internal-degree fraction
operations.description: Enumerate all gamma quasi-cliques via binary feasibility models; maximality is checked against all qualifying larger sets within the size bounds.

operations.title: Find capacity and bottlenecks between two places
operations.description: Maximum flow with a minimum-cut certificate; parallel capacities are summed.

operations.title: Select a non-conflicting group that cannot be extended
operations.description: A maximal independent set; no maximum-cardinality guarantee is made.

operations.title: Find the largest non-conflicting group
operations.description: Exact maximum independent set via maximum clique enumeration of the complement.

operations.title: Cover every connection with as few vertices as possible
operations.description: Exact minimum vertex cover through the complement of a maximum independent set.

operations.title: Compute a force-directed drawing of the network
operations.description: NetworkX Fruchterman-Reingold force iterations in 2D or 3D, with its explicit 0.01 distance regularization and no final rescaling. Recomputes the matching potential and maximum force. Convergence means a small force residual, not optimality of the drawing. Directed edges project to undirected; loops are removed; parallel weights sum (unweighted duplicates collapse).

iterations.description: Fixed iteration count; null/unbounded stopping is not supported by this profile.

initial_positions.description: Optional {vertex, value:[coordinates]} rows for every vertex, preserved when iterations=0.

optimal_distance.description: Force-law length k; defaults to 1/sqrt(vertex count).

operations.title: Match items on two sides by count, value, or cost
operations.description: NetworkX maximum-weight matching with explicit cardinality and coverage semantics. Minimum-cost without required coverage may legitimately choose an empty matching.

operations.title: Find the highest-value non-conflicting pairs
operations.description: Exact maximum-weight matching on an undirected graph, without a maximum-cardinality constraint.

operations.title: Count three-way connections
operations.description: Exact triangle count and optional per-vertex, per-edge and instance outputs.

operations.title: Connect at least one representative of every required group
operations.description: SciPy/HiGHS binary tree model with separated connectivity cuts. Covers every group and required vertex, removes self-loops, and retains the cheapest original parallel edge. Requires a completed numerical optimum; no terminal-only approximation is substituted for the group problem.

operations.title: Split a graph into balanced groups with few crossing edges
operations.description: Minimize crossing edge cost under both lower and upper balance limits and nonempty parts. Normalized cut is the sum of each part's boundary cost divided by its declared balance size.

vertex_weights.description: One {vertex, value} record per input vertex.

operations.title: Partition a hypergraph while preserving whole-group connections
operations.description: Binary assignment and hyperedge-part incidence optimize cut-net or connectivity-minus-one cost without a graph projection. Every part is nonempty and respects the upper weight bound.

operations.title: Check signed-network balance or minimize frustrated connections
operations.description: Structural balance is an exact parity test, independent of edge costs. Frustration minimization uses binary XOR constraints and recomputes the weighted violations.

operations.title: Count four-way connections between two sides
operations.description: Exact 2-by-2 biclique counts and participation. Core mode declares whether thresholds apply to ordinary degree or butterfly participation.

operations.title: Frequent patterns across graphs
operations.description: Exhaustive simple directed/undirected transaction mining. Support counts graphs, not occurrences. Includes disconnected patterns and isolated vertices within the declared edge/vertex bounds. Types are categorical; weights/times are ignored. Nonempty patterns by default; minimum_vertices=0 includes the empty pattern. BLISS canonicalization; exponential enumeration uses explicit work/output budgets.

minimum_support_fraction.description: Strictly positive fraction of transactions containing the pattern.

parallel_edges.description: Collapse requires identical selected edge types.

operations.title: Count connected induced graph shapes and vertex roles
operations.description: Classify induced subgraphs against NetworkX's complete graph atlas through seven vertices, with optional exact automorphism-orbit participation.

graphlet_sizes.description: Unique integer sizes 2 through 7; the atlas contains every unlabeled class in that range.

operations.title: Count occurrences of supplied graph motifs
operations.description: VF2 embeddings with explicit automorphism identity. Non-induced occurrences sharing a vertex set can still be different motif instances.

operations.title: Frequent labeled patterns within one graph
operations.description: Exact connected labeled patterns, including single-vertex patterns, in an undirected graph. Minimum-image support is the smallest distinct host image-set size across pattern vertices over all VF2 embeddings. BLISS deduplicates patterns. Every vertex needs the selected string label/type. Edge labels, weights and times are ignored. Count mode does not provide a pattern collection. Exponential work is budgeted.

include_images.description: Include original host image sets per pattern vertex; requires patterns output.

operations.title: Find every match for a supplied graph pattern
operations.description: NetworkX VF2 induced or non-induced matching. Preserves direction, loops and distinct parallel edges; declarative predicates constrain vertex and edge attributes.

operations.title: Count ordered temporal edge patterns
operations.description: NetworkX VF2 structural matching followed by injective event assignment, exact UTC time comparisons, order constraints and optional temporal inducedness. Distinct tuples in motif-edge order identify occurrences.

temporal_motif.description: graph: canonical motif; optional order: [before_edge_id, after_edge_id] pairs (default: total input-edge order); optional vertex_predicates/edge_predicates use the structural matching predicate schema.

operations.title: Find shared neighbors
operations.description: Intersect the direct neighbor sets of two typed entities in the requested direction. Self-loops retain their adjacency meaning.

direction.description: Traversal or per-vertex edge direction. Undirected edges are traversable both ways; self-loops count once per vertex.

edge_filters.description: AND of {field, op, value} predicates. Use explicit paths such as attributes.amount. Missing fields never match except exists=false; ID types are preserved.

result_limit.description: Optional retained-row cap. All matches are counted; capped collections are incomplete and cannot feed a downstream step.

operations.title: Filter relationships
operations.description: Select original relationship records without collapsing parallel edges or loops. Endpoint predicates use the stored source/target even on undirected inputs.

edge_filters.description: AND of {field, op, value} predicates. Use explicit paths such as attributes.amount. Missing fields never match except exists=false; ID types are preserved.

source_filters.description: AND of {field, op, value} predicates. Use explicit paths such as attributes.amount. Missing fields never match except exists=false; ID types are preserved.

target_filters.description: AND of {field, op, value} predicates. Use explicit paths such as attributes.amount. Missing fields never match except exists=false; ID types are preserved.

result_limit.description: Optional retained-row cap. All matches are counted; capped collections are incomplete and cannot feed a downstream step.

operations.title: Summarize recorded values
operations.description: Count records or sum/average/min/max an explicit numeric field, grouped by a field or vertex. Decimal arithmetic is exact in exact_value; value may be rounded. Missing numeric fields are errors. Per-vertex edge groups include isolates and count loops once.

filters.description: AND of {field, op, value} predicates. Use explicit paths such as attributes.amount. Missing fields never match except exists=false; ID types are preserved.

group_by.description: A record field, vertex for per-vertex groups, or null for one overall group. Edge source/target group by stored endpoints; vertex uses direction.

direction.description: Traversal or per-vertex edge direction. Undirected edges are traversable both ways; self-loops count once per vertex.

result_limit.description: Optional retained-row cap. All matches are counted; capped collections are incomplete and cannot feed a downstream step.

operations.title: Find nearby entities
operations.description: Find vertices reachable within hops over filtered relationships, with exact hop distances. Parallel edges do not duplicate vertices; include_seed controls the starting vertex.

direction.description: Traversal or per-vertex edge direction. Undirected edges are traversable both ways; self-loops count once per vertex.

edge_filters.description: AND of {field, op, value} predicates. Use explicit paths such as attributes.amount. Missing fields never match except exists=false; ID types are preserved.

result_limit.description: Optional retained-row cap. All matches are counted; capped collections are incomplete and cannot feed a downstream step.

operations.title: Look up entities
operations.description: Select original vertex records by typed IDs and AND predicates; no fuzzy name matching. An explicit empty IDs array selects nothing.

vertex_filters.description: AND of {field, op, value} predicates. Use explicit paths such as attributes.amount. Missing fields never match except exists=false; ID types are preserved.

result_limit.description: Optional retained-row cap. All matches are counted; capped collections are incomplete and cannot feed a downstream step.

operations.title: Find connections between two entities
operations.description: Enumerate all hop-shortest or all vertex-simple paths within max_hops, preserving edge IDs and parallel-edge alternatives. This is unweighted hop length, not minimum weight.

direction.description: Traversal or per-vertex edge direction. Undirected edges are traversable both ways; self-loops count once per vertex.

edge_filters.description: AND of {field, op, value} predicates. Use explicit paths such as attributes.amount. Missing fields never match except exists=false; ID types are preserved.

result_limit.description: Optional retained-row cap. All matches are counted; capped collections are incomplete and cannot feed a downstream step.

operations.title: Extract records as a graph
operations.description: Extract a vertex-induced, edge-induced, or filtered-neighborhood graph. Preserve original records, direction, weights, loops and parallel edges. Edge mode retains only endpoints; vertices mode can retain isolates.

direction.description: Traversal or per-vertex edge direction. Undirected edges are traversable both ways; self-loops count once per vertex.

vertex_filters.description: AND of {field, op, value} predicates. Use explicit paths such as attributes.amount. Missing fields never match except exists=false; ID types are preserved.

edge_filters.description: AND of {field, op, value} predicates. Use explicit paths such as attributes.amount. Missing fields never match except exists=false; ID types are preserved.

operations.title: Sample neighborhoods while retaining original edge identities
operations.description: Sample outgoing edge instances per distinct frontier vertex, hop and seed batch. Parallel edges and self-loops retain their identity. Typed fanouts and UTC timestamp cutoffs are explicit.

edge_type_fanouts.description: Map edge type to one fanout per hop; unlisted types use fanouts.

operations.title: Sample graph walks with an explicit transition model
operations.description: NumPy random sampling over outgoing adjacency. Uniform walks collapse parallel edges; weighted and node2vec walks sum weights. Self-loops are retained. Zero total outgoing weight terminates a walk.

operations.title: Score possible connections
operations.description: Exact local similarity scores for explicit pairs or all currently absent undirected edges.

operations.title: Compare vertices by the similarity of their neighbors
operations.description: SciPy solves the SimRank fixed-point equations with a separately recomputed residual and contraction error bound. Direction and output-pair scope are explicit.

operations.title: Smooth noisy measurements over a graph
operations.description: Minimize one-half squared observation error plus a declared Laplacian, total-variation or graph-trend penalty. Numerical accuracy is checked with stationarity or a feasible dual bound.

observed_signal.description: One {vertex, value} row per vertex; values are scalars or equal-width vectors.

operations.title: Compute graph Laplacian eigenvalues and eigenvectors
operations.description: SciPy symmetric eigensolver with explicit residual and orthogonality checks. The direct solver has no max_iterations parameter.

operations.title: Rank graph entities against an explicit normality reference
operations.description: NetworkX structural features and SciPy population statistics with declared standardized L1/L2/max scores. Supports vertices, original edge instances and explicitly supplied induced subgraphs. Reference populations are selected independently from candidates; no learned ground-truth anomaly claim is made.

feature_definitions.description: Rows with unique name and measure; numeric_attribute also needs field relative to attributes. Supported measures by target: vertex: degree, ego_edge_count, event_count, in_degree, in_event_count, in_strength, numeric_attribute, out_degree, out_event_count, out_strength, strength, triangle_count; edge: common_neighbors, edge_weight, numeric_attribute, source_degree, target_degree; subgraph: density, edge_count, numeric_attribute, vertex_count, weight_sum

normality_reference.description: kind=population with optional graph/entities/subgraphs, or kind=statistics with location/scale arrays.

subgraphs.description: Required for subgraph target: id, vertices, optional attributes.

operations.title: Compare a declared statistic with a random graph ensemble
operations.description: NetworkX uniform G(n,m), or configuration-model rejection sampling conditioned on a simple graph with the exact per-vertex degree sequence. Dense fixed-degree inputs are sampled through their complement. Statistical estimates retain their samples and declared tail convention.

statistic_definition.description: name: triangles, directed_triangles, k_cliques (k), density, or modularity (partition and optional resolution).

operations.title: Explore a selected group or neighborhood
operations.description: An induced graph on explicit vertices or a bounded-hop neighborhood, with original IDs and attributes.

operations.title: Find earliest arrivals or fastest journeys through timed events
operations.description: NetworkX shortest paths on an exact-rational time-expanded graph. Waiting is allowed; fastest duration excludes waiting before the first departure. Parallel events remain distinct candidates.

operations.title: Track components, loops and higher-dimensional holes across edge thresholds
operations.description: GUDHI flag-complex persistence over a declared prime field. Includes essential H0 intervals and enough cofaces to compute deaths in every requested homology dimension.

field_prime.description: Prime modulus; 46337 is GUDHI's documented maximum.

operations.title: Enumerate bounded simple paths or cycles
operations.description: NetworkX simple edge paths and bounded simple cycles, with explicit parallel-edge normalization and optional chronological filtering. A result limit retains the shortest results while still counting all qualifying results.

operations.title: Connections within a number of steps
operations.description: Exact unweighted distances from independent sources or the nearest supplied source.

operations.title: Shortest routes between selected places
operations.description: Exact pairwise distances; absent routes are returned as null.

operations.title: Shortest routes from one starting point
operations.description: Exact shortest distances and predecessors with nonnegative edge lengths.

operations.title: Find the k highest-cost paths through a DAG
operations.description: Edge-identity expansion plus exact rational Johnson reweighting allows NetworkX's shortest-simple-path iterator to rank longest DAG paths, including negative weights and parallel arcs.

operations.title: Order tasks by their dependencies
operations.description: A topological vertex order for a directed acyclic graph; cycles are rejected.

operations.title: Find which places can reach each other
operations.description: Exact reachability with a zero-length path allowed from each vertex to itself.

operations.title: Find the greatest bottleneck capacity from a source
operations.description: Threshold reachability using NetworkX BFS computes the max-min path objective with exact comparisons and witness predecessors. Zero capacity remains reachable.

operations.title: Connect the network with minimum or maximum total weight
operations.description: An exact minimum or maximum spanning forest, retaining isolated vertices.
